## Voidline vX.Y.Z

Binary-only Windows/.NET 9 release.

### Download
- `Voidline-vX.Y.Z.zip`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`

### Requirements
- Windows 10/11
- .NET 9 Desktop Runtime

### Notes
- Extract the complete ZIP.
- Keep the executable, DLLs, runtime JSON files, and `runtimes/` directory together.
- Verify the archive against `SHA256SUMS.txt` before use.
